statement: GST registration with Inland Revenue is compulsory for anyone carrying out a taxable activity whose turnover was at least $60,000 in the last 12 months or is expected to be at least $60,000 in the next 12 months, and for anyone carrying out a taxable activity who adds GST to the price of the goods or services they sell; registration below the threshold is voluntary.
caveat: The registration deadline and effective-date mechanics sit in Goods and Services Tax Act 1985 s 51 (legislation.govt.nz answers automated fetches with an AWS WAF challenge, recorded 2026-10-23, so the statutory timing is not quoted here), and the threshold figure changes at fiscal events. Check the live Inland Revenue page for when the registration must be filed before relying.
